text.body: ॥ śrīdakṣiṇāmūrticaturviṃśativarṇamālāstotram ।। omityetadasya budhairnāma gṛhītaṃ yadbhāstredaṃ bhāti samastaṃ viyadādi । yasyājñātaḥ svasvapadasthā vidhimukhyāstaṃ pratyañcaṃ dakṣiṇavaktraṃ kalayāmi ॥ 1 namrāṅgānāṃ bhaktimatāṃ yaḥ puruṣārthaṃ datte kṣipraṃ hanti ca tatsarvavipattīḥ। pādāmbhojāstanitāpasmṛtimīśaṃ taṃ... ॥ 2 mohadhvaṃtyai vaiṇikavaiyāsikamukhyātsaṃvinmudrāpukhakavīṇākṣaguṇānyam । hastāmbhojairbibhratamārādhitavaṃtastaṃ... ॥ 3 bhadrārūḍhaṃ bhadradamārādhayitṝṇāṃ bhaktiśraddhāpūrvakamīśaṃ praṇamanti । ādityā yaṃ vāñcitasidhyai karuṇābdhitaṃ... ॥ 4 garbhāntasthāḥ prāṇina ete bhavapāśacchede dakṣaṃ niścittavantaḥ śaraṇaṃ yam । ārādhyāṅghrim prasphuradambhoruhayugmaṃ taṃ ...॥ 5 vaktraṃ dhanyāssaṃsṛtivārdheratimātrādbhītāssantaḥ pūrṇaśaśāṅkadyuti yasya । sevante'dhyāsīnamanantaṃ vaṭamūlaṃ taṃ ... ॥ 6 tejastomairaṅgadasaṅghaṭṭitabhāsvanmāṇikyotthairbhāsitaviśvo rucirairyaḥ। tejomūrtiṃ khānilatejapramukhābdhitaṃ... ॥ 7 dadhyājyādidravyakakarmāṇyakhilāni tyaktvā kāṅkṣāṃ karmaphaleṣvatra karoti । yajjijñāsārūpaphalārthī kṣitidevastaṃ... ॥ 8 kṣipraṃ loke yaṃ bhajamānaḥ pṛthupuṇyaḥ pradhvastādhiḥ projjhitasaṃsṛtyakhilārtiḥ। pratyagbhūtaṃ brahma paraṃ satramate yastaṃ... ॥ 9 ṇānetyevaṃ yanmanumadhyasthitavarṇaṃ bhaktāḥ kāle varṇagṛhīteḥ prajapantaḥ । modaṃte samprāptasamastaśrutitantrāstaṃ... ॥ 10 mūrticchāyānirjitamandākinikundaprāleyāmbhorāśisudhābhūtisurebhā । yasyābhrāmā hāsavidhau dakṣaśirodhistaṃ ... ॥11 taptavarṇacchāyajaṭājūṭakaṭāha prodyadvīcīvallivirājansurasindhum । nityaṃ sūkṣmaṃ nityanirastākhiladoṣaṃ taṃ... ... ॥12 yena jñātenaiva samastaṃ viditaṃ syādyasmādanyadvastu jagatyāṃ śaśaśṛṅgam । yaṃ prāptānāṃ nāsti paraṃ prāpyamanādiṃ taṃ ... ॥13 matto māro yasya lalāṭākṣibhavāgnisphūrjatkīlaproṣitabhasmīkṛtadehaḥ tadbhasmāsīdyasya sujātaḥ paṭavāsastaṃ ...॥14 sambhorāśau saṃsṛtirūpe luṭhatāṃ tatpāraṃ gantuṃ yatpadabhaktirdṛḍhanaukā ... ॥15 sarvārādhyaṃ sarvagamānandapayodhiṃ taṃ ... ॥15 medhāvī syādiṃduvataṃsaṃ dhṛtavīṇaṃ karpūrābhaṃ pustakahastaṃ kamalākṣam । citte dhyāyanyasya vapurdrādaḍnimiṣārdhaṃ taṃ ...॥16 dhānnāṃ dhāma prauḍharucīnāṃ paramaṃ yatsūryādīnāṃ yasya sa heturjagadādeḥ । etāvanye yasya sa sarveśvaramīḍyaṃ taṃ ...॥17 pratyāhāraprāṇanirodhādisamarthaibhaktairdāntairasaṃyatacittairyatamānaiḥ । svātmatvena jñāyata eva tvarayā yastaṃ ... ॥18 jñāṃśībhūtānprāṇina etānphaladātā cittāntasthaḥ prerayati sve sakale'pi । kṛtye devaḥ prāktanakarmānusaratsan taṃ ...॥ 19 prajñāmātraṃ prāpitasaṃvinnijabhaktaṃ prāṇākṣādeḥ prerayitāraṃ praṇavārtham । prāhuḥ prājñā yaṃ viditānubhavatatvāstaṃ ...॥20 yastha jñānādeva nṛṇāṃ saṃsṛtibodho yasya jñānādeva vimokṣo bhavatīti । spaṣṭaṃ brūte vedaśirodeśikamādyaṃ taṃ... ॥21 chinne'vidyārūpavaṭe naiva ca viśvaṃ yatrādhyastaṃ jīvapareśatvamapīdam । bhānorbhānuṣvambuvadastākhilabhedaṃ taṃ... ॥22 svāpasvapnau jāgradavasthāpi na tatra prāṇaścetassarvagato yassakalātmā । kūṭastho yaḥ kevalasañcitsukharūpastaṃ ...॥23 hāhetyevaṃ vismayamīyurmunimukhyāḥ jñāte yasminsvātmatayā nātmavimohaḥ । pratyagbhūte brahmaṇi yātaḥ kathamitthaṃ taṃ... ॥24 yaiṣā ramyairmattamayūrābhidhavṛttairādau guptā yanmanuvarṇaitibhaṅgī । tāmevaitāṃ dakṣiṇavakraḥ kṛpayāsā dūrīkuryāddeśikasamrāṭparamātmā ॥25 ॥ iti śrīmacchaṅkarācāryaviracita dakṣiṇāmūrtivarṇamālāstotraṃ sampūrṇam ॥
